QUOTE: "Data is cleared by a rebuild. Code is cleared only by restarting the client. Schema cannot be cleared by any action the consumer can take."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the data axis is cleared by a rebuild and the code axis only by a client restart, and it reports the axes separately with their different remedies. It never says explicitly that this is why a single flag would not have been enough. The distinct-remedy mechanism is there, so I judged this a HIT.
